caption: The video captures a fixed wide view of a calm sea beneath a heavy, broken cloud layer, with the sun partly hidden near the center of the sky. A bright hole in the clouds lets the sun shine through, throwing a fan of crepuscular rays that slant downward toward the low horizon line. Directly below the sun, an elongated column of reflected light glitters on the water, its sparkle shifting as small ripples move across the surface. The texture of this glint changes from frame to frame, and faint dark ripple patterns in the foreground water drift slightly, marking the ongoing motion of the sea. The cloud arrangement, the opening around the sun, and the angle and spread of the rays drift slowly throughout, so the visible activity is distributed across both the shifting sky and the shimmering reflection. The camera framing stays fixed, keeping the horizon and the sun in the same positions.
relations: Sunlight through the cloud opening projects downward crepuscular rays onto the calm sea surface.
Small surface ripples continuously shift the specular reflection, altering the glittering texture of the light column.
Slow cloud drift slightly changes the opening size and ray angles while the fixed camera keeps the horizon stable.
